summary: Wing Yip Food Holdings Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of its 11th annual general meeting held on April 22, 2026. Shareholders voted on 11 resolutions including approval of financial statements, amendments to articles of association, re-election of directors and supervisory committee members, share consolidation at a 4:1 ratio, delegation of share and bond issuance authorities, and re-appointment of auditors. Resolution No. 9 on director remuneration (cap RMB10 million) was rejected. No special situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, going-private, or restructuring is present. This is a routine meeting notice with no forced management change.
